start.title: Your first hero
start.intro: Choose a hero. Make the story your own.

blocks.title: One free permanent hero
blocks.text: Use Choose Free Hero, then Confirm Free Hero on an eligible hero. This choice does not spend Eternity Splinters.

blocks.title: Try before you choose
blocks.text: Available trial heroes can reach level 10. Permanently unlock a hero to continue beyond the trial cap.

blocks.title: Earn the rest
blocks.text: Collect Eternity Splinters as you play, then use the roster or shop to unlock more heroes. The catalog lists reference unlock costs.

blocks.title: Bring a Team-Up
blocks.text: Select an owned companion in Team-Up Heroes with Set Active. Active marks the selected companion. Press K to summon your Team-Up.

blocks.title: Three ways to see the world
blocks.text: Press V or F6 to cycle third person, overhead and first person. Third person is selected when a level loads.

blocks.title: Smooth follow-camera zoom
blocks.text: Scroll up to move closer and down to pull back. The third-person camera remembers its zoom when you change views.

blocks.title: Controller camera
blocks.text: With controller input active, use the right stick to orbit in third-person and first-person views. The camera holds its angle when the stick returns to center.

blocks.title: Achievements shortcut
blocks.text: Press Shift + V to open Achievements.
